text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Could I have been a bit more decisive in 
that race? No, given today's condition...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The things to reflect on are truly 
endless.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer, how was 
it? I'd like to hear your thoughts for our 
next race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please give me your candid opinion.
choice_data_list:
That was a race with a lot of room for 
improvement.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So we should take the good 
points from today and build on them for 
the next race."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you look only in one direction, you'll 
lose your balance. I must switch gears. In 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was thinking the exact same thing. 
Sometimes resetting your mindset lets you 
see new things.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Could we stop by a bicycle 
shop on the way back? I wanted to get some 
new maintenance tools.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To take a quick breather, I decided to 
accompany Ikuno Dictus on her shopping 
trip on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First, we identify areas for 
improvement. If we thoroughly address each 
of them—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Victory is within reach. ...This time, for 
sure.
choice_data_list:
Room for improvement is just a 'hint 
toward victory,' after all.

Room for improvement is just a 'hint 
toward victory,' you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we swore our next victory to each 
other.
